name: Federation / Topology
description: Hierarchy or network of separately identifiable knowledge states. Distributed campuses, organizational units and linked subsystems.
reference_use_case: Distributed campuses, organizational units and linked subsystems.
integrity_rule: A parent reference does not own or absorb a child state.
antipattern: Do not copy subordinate commitments or assume a parent owns each referenced child.
design_question: Where does ownership end, and which child commitments are pinned?
situational_schema: Independent knowledge states linked by topology, scope, and separately owned parent-child references.
